B7_CONTRADICTORY_SOURCES.description: Current tariff sources disagree materially for the same operator/estate and the conflict cannot be resolved from authoritative first-party evidence.
B7_CONTRADICTORY_SOURCES.nextAction: Reconcile the conflicting station/EVSE records against first-party checkout, AFIR/DATEX II and source timestamps; retain fail-closed until one binding current price is established.
